stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"On a company's page, the filter 'במה הכסף מושקע' is useless: each of its choices holds a single track.","where":"the filter chips above the tracks list","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Doesn't know which product their savings are in; the page opened on the קופת גמל להשקעה tab, so their choice may be for a product they don't have
Unsure whether the higher-returning מניות track is actually better, given the past-returns caveat
The '123 ממקור · 123 מחושב · 123 הזנה' line is confusing and meaningless to them
Product tab names (תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים, מקיפה vs כללית) mean nothing to them
Filter chip names (משולב סחיר, עוקב מדדים - גמיש, כספי) are just words to them
The direct-expenses footer line makes them worry about hidden costs
Doesn't understand how קרנות מחקות / מרכזית לפיצויים / קרנות סל differ from what they already saw
The 'מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל' section looks like fine print; would drop it
The 'מההפקדה 0%' line is the same in every row and tells them nothing
Doesn't understand what מט"ח means or what the donut charts and colours add beyond the number
Misread 'פחות מ־3 שנים / פחות מ־5 שנים' as a return value
Doesn't understand terms like אג"ח, סחיר, אשראי, משולב, חשיפה
Returns are shown before fees; wants a single after-fees return figure
Can't find how to switch tracks or whether switching costs anything
No guidance on whether a 24-year-old should go all stocks, or plain-language explanations of the tracks
No comparison of Harel's S&P 500 track with other companies on the page itself
Would drop the 'לא מצאתם שם?' search box
Would drop the קופה column

problems.why: The reader mentions the filter chips, including the S&P 500 chip showing '1', but only says the chip names are unclear. They never say the filter is useless because each choice holds one track.
